message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code only reads files uploaded directly by users or from local disk; it does not fetch data from any remote source such as a URL, S3, or HuggingFace Hub, so no integrity verification or source authentication is applicable or present.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious input filtering steps applied to the training data before modeling.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch (CatBoostClassifier) and does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models, so no integrity verification (hash check, signature, or pinned revision) is performed.
No detected label distribution validation: The code performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomaly detection on training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used; CatBoost is trained without any DP mechanisms.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a train/test split is performed, the test set is not isolated from the Optuna tuning loop (it is passed directly to optuna_learning for evaluation), there is no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and only a single metric (ROC-AUC/Gini) is used without independent validation.
No detected output bounds checks: The run() function and inference path perform no sanity checks on model outputs (e.g., probability bounds, NaN guards) before returning or logging results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a tabular CatBoost classifier, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
